reason: At least the price is on the page and 59 a month is not crazy, but 'connects to your CRM...' tells me nothing. I already run Zapier and HubSpot, and I don't know if this plugs into them or what 100 'credits' actually buys me. I might poke at the free plan, but I won't pay this month.
objection: Vague integrations and credits I can't translate into real work. If it can't read and write to my HubSpot properly, it's just one more tab, and I don't know how fast 100 credits burn.
would_change_my_mind: A public integrations list showing native HubSpot and Zapier/Make support, plus a plain table of what one credit does (one email, one lead qualified, one ticket answered).
